data.overview: The Ayurveda Experience is a Singapore-founded house of Ayurvedic skincare sub-brands (including iYURA) that markets itself as natural, safe, cruelty-free, and with vegan options. Its own sites claim it never tests on products on animals and offers a dedicated vegan collection, while an independent 2026 review reports both strong multi-year customer loyalty and specific product-quality complaints (staining, a rancid body oil, and a skin reaction). No brand-specific legal or regulatory matters appear in the fetched sources.

claims.quote: The Ayurveda Experience's VEGAN POWER POTIONS! We NEVER test our products on animals. FREE SHIPPING OVER $28 USD

papers.title: The Ayurveda Experience Review — Does Ayurvedic Skincare Actually Work?
papers.summary: This independent review synthesizes Trustpilot and other sources on The Ayurveda Experience, reporting substantial multi-year customer loyalty and standout products like the Balaayah Black Gram Body Booster and Kesaradi Face Oil, alongside specific quality complaints: a face oil staining clothing, a body oil turning rancid on bedding, a neck mask causing itching and redness, and poorly handled returns/shipping. It notes the products are 100% natural, cruelty-free, with vegan options, but 'Ayurveda-inspired' rather than strictly traditional.

findings.text: The review reports the brand is cruelty-free with vegan options, confirmed directly, alongside 100% natural and non-GMO claims.
findings.quote: 100% natural, non-GMO, cruelty-free, with vegan options — confirmed directly, with ingredients rooted in documented Ayurvedic tradition

findings.text: A documented account describes a body oil turning rancid and transferring to bedding, a specific product-integrity concern.
findings.quote: A body oil specifically developed a rancid smell that transferred to bedding — “it turned out the oil was rubbing off on my sheets and becoming rancid”

findings.text: A specific account describes a neck mask causing an immediate skin reaction.
findings.quote: A separate, specific account describes a neck mask causing “immediate itching and redness” — a documented skin reaction account worth direct mention for buyers with sensitive skin

findings.text: A shipping complaint describes a late order with a promised gift item never delivered despite customer service assurances.
findings.quote: One specific shipping account describes an order arriving a week late with a promised gift item never included, with customer service promising to “send it right away”

findings.text: The review notes broadly positive Trustpilot sentiment across both UK and US markets with responsive brand engagement.
findings.quote: UK Trustpilot (1,006 reviews) and US Trustpilot (805 reviews) both reflect broadly positive sentiment with responsive brand engagement on negative reviews
